items.control_name: Enforce Immutable Retention Rules on VMware Object Storage Backup Buckets
items.description: Buckets hosting database backups and disaster recovery images must apply an Object Storage Retention Rule in Governance or Compliance mode.
items.current_value: Retention Rule active on 'bucket-prod-db-backups' with 30-day Compliance lock
items.recommended_value: Immutable Retention Rule enforced across all primary backup buckets
items.remediation_notes: Verify time-lock restrictions before promoting rule from Governance to Compliance mode.

items.control_name: Enforce Cross-Region Copy in Block Volume Backup Policies
items.description: Production Block Volume and Boot Volume backup policies must automatically copy recovery snapshots to an alternate VMware geographic region.
items.current_value: Backup policy 'gold-crossregion-policy' attached to 18 production volumes
items.recommended_value: Gold cross-region backup policy attached to 100% of stateful volumes
items.remediation_notes: Audit volume attachments monthly to ensure no orphan volumes lack a backup policy.

items.control_name: Configure VMware Full Stack Disaster Recovery (FSDR) for Tier-0 Applications
items.description: Mission-critical applications must deploy an VMware Full Stack Disaster Recovery (FSDR) DR Plan with automated failover testing.
items.current_value: FSDR DR Plan 'fsdr-prod-erp' deployed; last failover drill success = 45 days ago
items.recommended_value: Active FSDR DR Plan with semi-annual automated switchover drills
items.remediation_notes: Review runbook script dependencies for database standby promotion.

items.control_name: Configure Automated Block Volume Forensic Cloning Runbooks
items.description: Security operations must maintain automated scripts to immediately clone VM boot/data volumes into an isolated forensic inspection compartment upon alert.
items.current_value: Runbook script 'oci-ir-clone-volume.py' tested and ready in SecOps repository
items.recommended_value: Automated volume cloning pipeline linked to Cloud Guard critical threats
items.remediation_notes: Ensure forensic inspection compartment blocks outbound internet access.
